newsitem.title: USA: Nastech licenses Nascobal to Schwarz.
newsitem.headline: Nastech licenses Nascobal to Schwarz.

text.p: Nastech Pharmaceutical Co Inc and Schwarz Pharma Inc said they entered into an exclusive agreement, giving Schwarz Pharma rights to market Nascobal Gel for Intranasal Administration in the U.S.
The agreement also gave Schwarz Pharma the right to obtain exclusive licenses to market the product in major countries in Europe and Asia.
Nastech said it retains global manufacturing rights.
The product, which is administered through the nose, is a treatment for vitamin B-12 deficiencies, particularly in patients with pernicious anemia.
Under terms of the agreement, Nastech said it will receive royalty payments tied to sales volume from Schwarz Pharma on annual net sales of the product in the U.S.
In addition, there is a guaranteed minimum royalty payment of $2 million in 1998, and a fixed manufacturing transfer price during the term of the agreement, Nastech said.
The product is scheduled to be launched no later than January 1998, and Nastech said it will begin shipping commercial quantities in the fourth quarter of this year.
